description: This file defines the FontManager class responsible for managing font files in the SuiteCRM's PDF generation module. It includes methods for loading font details, listing available fonts, adding new fonts, and deleting existing ones.

classes.name: FontManager
classes.description: A class for managing font files used in PDF generation, including functionalities to load font details, list, add, delete fonts, and handle font caching.

methods.name: listFontFiles
methods.description: Lists all available font files, loading from cache if available, otherwise parsing font directories.

methods.name: getSelectFontList
methods.description: Returns an array suitable for select options, with display names of available fonts.

methods.name: deleteFont
methods.description: Deletes a font file and related cached files, verifying admin privileges.

methods.name: addFont
methods.description: Adds a new font to the system by processing font and metric files, with options for styling and embedding.

methods.name: clearCachedFile
methods.description: Deletes the cached font list file.

methods.name: fontFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific font filename exists in the font directories.
